_comment: Fragment to merge into ravengun/dongles/schema.json. Adds a fourth dongle type, sega-keychip, for the SEGA ALLS AM Daemon keychip. The existing sega-scan type stays as-is for the Ring Shell.exe path, which is a different mechanism. Only the additions are listed here; the surrounding document is unchanged.
_adoption: 2. Add the properties block below to properties.
3. Add the if/then entry below to allOf.
5. Document in dongles/README.md that this type is answered by a CreateFileW + DeviceIoControl hook in the daemon process, not by a HASP-style API.

device.description: The Windows device path the keychip is reached through. Measured: \\.\FddDriver (the daemon opens \??\FddDriver via its \\.\%s pattern).

modeltype.description: 1 = Server, 2 = Satellite, 3 = Live. Source: hwvalue.exe usage text.

region.description: Bit flags, not an enum: 1 = JPN, 4 = EXP, 8 = CHN; AND-combined, optionally masked. Source: hwvalue.exe usage text.

platformId.description: e.g. ACA0 = ALLS UX, ACA1 = ALLS HX, from pxGetHwInfo.ini.

nearfull.description: minime/src/billing.ts uses 0x00010200 = 66048; 'Keychip odometer limit. Game will lock out if the odometer reaches ...'.

signaturePubKey.description: Path inside the dongle folder; minime/initpki generates one.

caCertification.description: Path inside the dongle folder. minime/initpki writes the CA as DER, budget 1024 bytes.

value.description: Dip-switch application value. Known bit: 4 = Terminal.

backupRecord.description: Optional path; the keychip keeps a dip-switch backup record on the AMFS system file (sysfile.dat).

geometry.description: From amyDongleGetGeometryNvram; the daemon range-checks every read against it.

files.description: Map of nvram index to a file inside the dongle folder.

ioctls.description: The captured DeviceIoControl stream. Empty until measurement C2 in REPORT.md section 6 has been run.

in.description: Optional path to the recorded input buffer.

out.description: Optional path to the recorded output buffer.

not_implemented_in_libam.description: MEASURED: the daemon's own library answers 'Function "..." is not implemented.' for these amDongle* functions, so they never reach the device. Recorded for completeness; a shim must not answer them.

test_harness.description: hwvalue.exe exercises the same ABI and prints modeltype/region/dipsw as text; use it as the unit test for this descriptor.
